newsitem.title: USA: Carolina Brunswick 1 nuke hits full power.
newsitem.headline: Carolina Brunswick 1 nuke hits full power.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's 767 megawatt (MW) Brunswick nuclear power unit 1 reached full output over the weekend after a maintenance reduction last week, a company spokesman said.
"We are back at 100 percent right now," spokesman Mac Harris said Tuesday.

The Southport, N.C. unit was reduced to about 58 percent power last week for feedwater temperature adjustments. It is scheduled to be shut down for 42 days from October 5 for refueling and maintenance. The 754 MW Brunswick unit 2 is also operating at 100 percent of capacity, Harris said.
